title: The list she left in the cutlery drawer
author: Ana Popescu
body:
She left a piece of paper folded twice in the cutlery drawer, where she knew somebody would eventually look for a knife.

It said: water the two on the windowsill, not the one by the door, it is already gone. Give the good shears to Radu. Tell the school I want them to keep the microscope with my name on it and let a child use it, not put it in a cupboard. And then, halfway down the page, in the same blue ink: stop reading this and go and eat something.
